metadata.description: Agents, skills, and starter kits for Microsoft Discovery (AI for Science), categorized by scientific domain

plugins.name: discovery-tools
plugins.description: Agents, skills, and starter kits for Microsoft Discovery — the AI for Science platform. Life-sciences data skills for SABIO-RK, BRENDA, BioCyc/EcoCyc/CyanoCyc, AlphaFold DB, and Rhea/ChEBI/MetaNetX/UniProt identifier crosswalks, plus cross-domain skills for scientific database access, evidence QC, Discovery agent deployment, project pre-flight clarification, and task design, workspace token-usage mining, live project dashboards, evidence-true project story replays, arxiv-ready paper builds, and DOE literature retrieval. Every skill declares its scientific category and subfield.

plugins.name: discovery-project-kit
plugins.description: Curated subset of discovery-tools for running a Microsoft Discovery project: deploy catalog agents, watch outcomes and engine runs, keep the project's records (exhaust and token usage), and write it up as a paper. Pair with the discovery-project-kit starter kit to add the pinned upstream token estimator.
